recipes.name: Goat Cheese and Arugula over Penne
ingredients_raw: 2 cups coarsely chopped arugula, stems included

steps.text: Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.
Crumble goat cheese into a large serving bowl. Add arugula, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Drain pasta; toss with goat cheese mixture until well combined.

raw_recipe.headline: Goat Cheese and Arugula over Penne
raw_recipe.description: Combine goat cheese with arugula, cherry tomatoes, olive oil, and garlic; toss with hot penne pasta for an absolutely delicious, yet simple summertime dish.

review.reviewBody:
I thought this recipe was good. I give it 5 stars for being quick and easy to make and 3 stars for overall taste (4 stars overall). Next time I make it (and I will make it again)I will:

(1) Sauté the garlic. I am a huge garlic fan but the fresh garlic taste in this recipe was overpowering and did not mix well with the other ingredients. I think the flavor would be better if it were sautéed for a few minutes.

(2) Add a few more vegetables...perhaps mushrooms and sun dried tomatoes. You could even sauté the mushrooms and the garlic together.

(3) Add some freshly grated parmesan cheese. The goat cheese was good but I think the added tang of some parmesan would be delicious.

I re-heated this recipe the next day and it did not work well. It still tasted good, but it was not the same. This is not necessarily a bad thing though! A recipe like this, full of fresh ingredients, shouldn't be saved for leftovers.

Overall, this was a very tasty dish...thanks!

This is a fantastic side dish for any meat. Everyone loves it. The secret is to QUARTER the tomatoes that give it a zing, and finely mince the garlic. I put everything together except the pasta and let it sit for 30 minutes so the flavors combine before cooking the pasta. I also added 4 TBS of hot pasta water to the dish. Last time I made this I added a teaspoon of lemon zest and that really added flavor. Instead of the baked potato, this was terrific with a perfectly grilled filet mignon.

I have made this recipe several times and always an entire box of penne pasta using an 8 oz goat cheese log in the recipe. I do add a diced onion, sliced mushrooms and sliced red peppers that I first cook in the olive oil. Last time I also added a finely chopped small dried jalapeño and it was quite good. Just enough heat lingering on the tongue. I also add pasta water to make the sauce more creamy and adhere well.

I sautéed some mushrooms and garlic (doubled the garlic) mixed everything together in the pan with the mushrooms and garlic .and added a little reserved pasta water. It was very delicious and easy to prepare. I will be making it again for sure.

I added in about 1/4 cup good parmesan and used 1/2 cup reserved pasta water when making the sauce (or adding the goat cheese really).
I think the subtle nuttiness of the parmesan took the flavor up a notch and the pasta water made it very creamy.
I added lots more tomatoes as I like them and the cooked ones kind of disappeared.
Will most definitely make again as I stated here. Nummy

I added a few mushrooms, a little onion and sun dried tomatoes and sauteed them beforehand with the garlic. I also added a little pasta water, lemon juice, white wine and cayenne as suggested by previous reviews. We really enjoyed it!

I actually made this is a hot dish, sautéed the garlic in olive oil with the salt and pepper (I probably used about 4 cloves) and added about 3-4 cups of arugula and about a cup of spinach and then added the tomatoes. I let that sauté until the leaves wilted and then added the goat cheese and melted that until it covered the ingredients. When the pasta was done and drained, I added that to the sauce and made sure the sauce covered the pasta completely. This was really yummy on both the first day and heated up. Thanks for the recipe!

The recipe, with these ratios, turns out way too dry. The retro Weight Watchers recipe I suspect it's based on uses 4 times the amount of tomatoes this one recommends. If you want to make the goat cheese into a creamy sauce like in the picture, throwing in a little pasta water when you toss everything together will do that. That's what i do, then put some more goat cheese crumbles on top to serve.

Wonderful! Changed it a bit . . . I started by sauteing some red onion in some of the olive oil. I added baby spinach to the arugula for a total of 4 cups, which I added to the onions to "wilt." I felt like I didn't have enough greens after that, and added a little more spinach and about 2 more cups arugula to the pasta. My package of goat cheese was 4 oz, so I was a little short on goat cheese - but I don't think it made a big difference. I did add maybe 1/2 cup shredded parmesan. And I used grape tomatoes. Will enjoy this for work dinners for the rest of the week! Yum! (Oh! I did not bother to chopped the greens . . . )

Love it !! One of our fav's... we do add a package of feta to the goat cheese and warm it slightly in the pot after all mixed together at the end. Gives us a creamy cheese finish at the end still keeping the freshness of the arugala

Easy to make and very flavorful. This was a hit with everyone who tried it. I used 3 largish cloves of fresh garlic and mixed the garlic, salt, pepper and olive oil together about an hour before to let the garlic flavor come through.
Good. I used a high protein pasta so it was a complete meal. I should have kept back some pasta water to thin it out. I'll make it again, maybe with spinach and Alouette cheese.
Extremely easy to make and creamy. Needs a protein like chicken and it's perfect.

Yay! So glad to add this to my easy and nutritious go-to meals! I made half the recipe, used Walmart Marketplace goat chz and an air-fried frozen chicken breast. I have three meals for less than $5 total. Thank you!
Added lots of salt and pepper, also added garlic butter shrimp. I thought it was just ok but my partner liked it.
I added some sautéed shrimp, but I’m sure it would be good with roasted or poached chicken. This is delicious! I love the tangy goat cheese. Oh, it’s also a very quick recipe!
keeper dish. Excellent. Used goat cheese with honey and added shrimp cooked in butter and garlic to make it a complete meal (with garlic bread). Healthy and packed with taste.
Easy to make fast prep work, great flavor
I modified by using sun dried tomatoes, toasted the pine nuts and sautéed the garlic along with the sun dried tomatoes. Used feta cheese. Excellent recipe.
Added a bit of cream cheese and added shrimp that I cooked on the stove top in a garlic butter - yum !
